text: CELLO (Nielsen et al., 2016) automates the ___ step of circuit engineering, converting a Boolean function (given as a truth table or Verilog-like HDL) into DNA sequences built from characterized genetic gates.
explanation: CELLO automates the Design step of the DBTL cycle: given a desired Boolean function, it searches a library of characterized transcription-factor gates, assigns them to the abstract logic gates, and outputs DNA sequences implementing the circuit. Build, Test, and Learn still require physical DNA assembly, wet-lab measurement, and model comparison, which CELLO does not perform.
